articles.headline: Appeals court says Pentagon can blacklist Anthropic’s AI technology
articles.summary: A federal appeals court ruling could affect Anthropic’s access to government business and set a precedent for how defense agencies evaluate AI vendors. For companies selling AI into regulated sectors, the case highlights growing compliance and procurement risk around model use and security reviews.

articles.headline: Nvidia lifts buyback authorization by a record $150 billion
articles.summary: Nvidia’s huge buyback boost signals management confidence and can influence sentiment across semiconductors, AI infrastructure, and related suppliers. Business buyers should watch it as a marker of continued capital intensity in AI hardware and the broader cost structure for compute.

articles.headline: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
articles.summary: Opening checkout to AI agents could change how online sales are routed, optimized, and automated across e-commerce workflows. For merchants, this may lower friction in digital sales operations while also forcing new controls for fraud, attribution, and agent-driven buying behavior.
